description:
U Bancroft is ideally located in the heart of Tallaght Village, offering superb convenience with a wide range of amenities on your doorstep.

Property Features:

- High energy efficient apartments
- Spacious layouts
- Fully fitted kitchens with stone countertops and integrated appliances
- High-quality finishes throughout
- Bright, well-proportioned living spaces
- Parking available

Location Highlights:

- Prime village setting in Tallaght with Tesco on site
- Close to shops, cafés, restaurants & everyday services
- Well serviced by Dublin Bus routes 27, 54a, 65 & 77a
- Minutes from The Square Shopping Centre & Old Bawn Shopping Centre
- Close to The Civic Theatre & Tallaght Library
- Adjacent to Tallaght Hospital
- Excellent road connectivity via the M50, N81 & N7
- Perfectly positioned for those seeking convenience, connectivity and access to a vibrant local community.

***Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search.***
